January 1-8, 2026 | Natural Disasters Summary 

January 1, 2026
Sicily, Italy | Mount Etna eruption with lava flows in Valle del Bove
San Diego, USA | Flash floods after heavy rain, multiple water rescues
Çatak, Turkey | Avalanches hit villages, one fatality, mass evacuations
Tacuarembó, Uruguay | Severe storm with hail, strong winds, power outages
Córdoba, Argentina | Violent storm with hurricane-force winds, one death

January 2, 2026
Irecê, Brazil | Urban flooding after intense rainfall
Guerrero Coast, Mexico | M6.5 earthquake, fatalities and widespread damage
Salta, Argentina | Torrential rain and large hail flooded cities
Banten, Indonesia | Major flooding in Cilegon and Serang, mass evacuations
Vratsa, Bulgaria | Hurricane-force winds, fatalities and power outages

January 3, 2026
Youssoufia, Morocco | River overflow caused residential flooding
Bursa, Turkey | Gale-force winds disrupted transport and daily life
North Island, New Zealand | Severe storms with hail, lightning, waterspouts
Marin County, USA | Coastal flooding from king tides and heavy rain
Poções, Brazil | Flash flooding submerged streets and vehicles

January 4, 2026
Lazio, Italy | Tornado damaged residential areas near Rome
Taroudant Province, Morocco | Severe storm caused floods and evacuations
Málaga Province, Spain | River flooding forced evacuations
Słupsk, Poland | Historic snowfall paralyzed transport

January 5, 2026
North Sulawesi, Indonesia | Deadly mudflows after heavy rain
Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic | Flooding in cities and resort areas
Chubut, Argentina | Large wildfire forced evacuations
Ponte de Lima, Portugal | Rare winter wildfire in mountainous terrain
Western Cape, South Africa | Major wildfire threatened coastal communities

January 6, 2026
Durrës, Albania | Severe flooding, evacuations, schools closed
Gjakova, Kosovo | Rivers overflowed, homes flooded, evacuations
Shimane, Japan | Strong earthquake disrupted transport
Krumovgrad, Bulgaria | Flash floods cut off villages

January 7, 2026
Oujda, Morocco | Rare snowfall after 25 years
West Halmahera, Indonesia | Floods and landslides killed residents
Davao Oriental, Philippines | M6.7 offshore earthquake

January 8, 2026
Cebu City, Philippines | Landslide at landfill killed one, many trapped
Istanbul, Turkey | Violent storm with hurricane-force winds
Belarus | Powerful winter cyclone caused outages nationwide
